trap.label: relato cultural
trap.wrong: I experienced a tea ceremony. The host said me that people were interested of it.
trap.right: I experienced a tea ceremony. The host said that people were interested in it.
trap.why: Experience não é só “experiência”: em inglês também é verbo (viver algo). E interested leva in (não of); e say não leva pessoa.

mcq.q: The host said ___ it was old.

fix.wrong: He said me it was nice.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: Host: “Tea is served warm.” (The host said...)
rewrite.answer: The host said that tea was served warm.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “People are interested in the show.”
rewrite.answer: People were interested in the show.

rewrite.prompt: Troque assisted por attended: “I assisted a concert.”
